name: Natural (geologic) hydrogen
principle: Hydrogen occurs naturally in the subsurface, produced by water-rock reactions or radiolysis, or can be stimulated in place. The only commercial production to date is Bourakebougou in Mali at 5 tpa. In June 2025 Gold H2 reported a bio-stimulated trial in a depleted California oil well giving gas with 40% hydrogen.
